key_insight: PeriaTrace links tooth-level findings on periapical radiographs to image evidence and generates technical reports alongside patient-friendly explanations.
clinical_relevance: The framework could speed up draft reporting and support clearer patient communication while retaining clinician review.
method: Identify individual teeth and diagnose radiographic findings.
Generate reports with tooth-level visual grounding.
Translate findings into plain-language explanations and care recommendations.
evidence_signal: Developed and evaluated using 12,877 radiographs across an internal dataset and two external cohorts, PeriaTrace generated reports in 4.41 seconds per image on average; external reviewers judged 91.16% and 84.52% suitable for retention or revision without complete rewriting.
watch_item: Report acceptability and survey preferences do not establish diagnostic safety or improved patient outcomes; clinical oversight remains necessary.
paper_title: PeriaTrace: Tooth-Level Grounding Diagnosis and Patient-Facing Explanations from Periapical Radiographs
